declaration.preface:
Val Organics Private Limited plays a vital role in promoting sustainable and responsible business practices. Our Labor & Human Rights Policy emphasizes our dedication to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, guiding our operations towards a balanced approach that prioritizes both economic success and social and environmental well-being. At the heart of our values lies a commitment to upholding workers' rights and ensuring optimal working conditions. We firmly believe that a healthy and empowered workforce is the foundation for sustainable growth.

We build strong stakeholder relationships based on transparency, engagement, and mutual respect. We actively solicit feedback from employees, customers, communities, and other stakeholders to continuously refine our practices. Embracing ethical business conduct, Val Organics upholds the highest standards of integrity and accountability in all aspects of our operations. Our commitment goes beyond compliance, as we strive to proactively contribute to the betterment of the communities where we operate.

Furthermore, we pledge to proactively address environmental concerns, minimizing our ecological footprint and advancing responsible resource management. Through these collective efforts, Val Organics aims to set a benchmark for social responsibility within the chemical industry. We foster a culture of sustainability and ethical conduct, one that aligns with our vision for a brighter and more inclusive future.
declaration.declaration:
Val Organics Limited is dedicated to upholding the highest standards of labor practices and human rights. We believe in creating a safe, fair, and inclusive work environment for all employees. This commitment translates into:

Equal Treatment: We prohibit discrimination and promote equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of background.

Safe Workplaces: We prioritize employee health and safety by providing a secure environment free from harm.

Fair Compensation: We offer competitive wages and benefits, respecting worker rights and well-being.

Respectful Workplace: We foster a culture of dignity and respect, free from harassment or abuse.

Continuous Improvement: We regularly review and update our practices to ensure we remain a leader in ethical labor practices.

By upholding these principles, we build a strong foundation for a thriving and sustainable Val Organics.

Val Organics Limited is committed to fostering a work environment that upholds the highest standards of labor practices and human rights. We believe in treating all employees with dignity and respect, regardless of background, ethnicity, gender, religion, or any other protected characteristic. This policy outlines our commitment to creating a safe, inclusive, and empowering workplace for all.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Employee Engagement, Community Impact & Workplace Relations
Cultivate Inclusion & Equality in the Workplace

Workforce Empowerment: We promote equal opportunities for all employees and prohibit discrimination in any form.
We conduct unconscious bias training for all managers and employees.
Achieve a zero-tolerance policy for harassment and discrimination of any kind.
Prioritize Employee Health & Protection: We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment free from physical, psychological, and verbal abuse.
We implement a comprehensive safety program and conduct regular workplace safety assessments.
Offer confidential channels for employees to report any safety or health concerns.
Improve Employment Atmosphere: We foster a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment that values employee contributions and supports employee well-being, productivity, and work-life balance.
We are committed to maintaining fair working conditions, including reasonable working hours, adequate rest periods, fair compensation, employee welfare benefits, and healthy working arrangements.
We conduct regular employee engagement and satisfaction surveys and implement improvement initiatives based on employee feedback.
Employee Engagement, Community Impact &: We are committed to fostering a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive workplace built on open communication, mutual trust, and positive engagement between employees and management.
We believe in supporting the communities where we operate and encourage employee participation in volunteer and community development initiatives.
We engage employees through regular communication forums, feedback mechanisms, and community involvement programs to strengthen workplace relationships and social impact.
We maintain fair and transparent processes for addressing employee concerns, grievances, and workplace issues.
Support Professional Growth & Education: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development.
We offer training and development opportunities to help employees enhance their skills and knowledge.
Provide career development resources and mentorship programs for employees.
Eradicate Exploitive Labor Practices: We strictly prohibit all forms of forced labor, child labor, and human trafficking.
We conduct regular audits of our supply chain to ensure compliance with labor laws.
Cultivate Inclusion & Equality in the Wo: We promote a workplace culture that celebrates diversity and fosters inclusion for all employees.
We establish diversity and inclusion committees to represent different employee perspectives.
Develop and implement a diversity and inclusion action plan with measurable goals.
Conduct diversity and inclusion training for all leadership positions.
Employee Well-being, Work-Life Balance &: We promote healthy working arrangements that support employee well-being, productivity, and work-life balance.
We provide access to employee well-being, mental health support, and wellness initiatives.
We are committed to providing ergonomic workstations and promoting safe work practices to enhance employee comfort, health, and productivity.
We conduct periodic ergonomic assessments, provide appropriate equipment, and implement safe lifting and handling practices to minimize ergonomic risks.

responsibilities.duty: Lead Policy Development and Implementation: Draft, implement, and maintain the LHR policy.
Review Policy Effectiveness: Periodically review the LHR Policy to assess implementation progress, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend necessary updates.
Develop Training Programs: Design and deliver training programs on LHR principles, workplace rights, and complaint procedures for employees and managers.
Grievance Resolution: Establish a clear grievance procedure, investigate complaints, and facilitate fair resolutions.
Monitor Compliance: Monitor adherence to LHR policies and regulations through audits and internal reviews.
Data Collection and Reporting: Track progress on LHR goals and report findings to relevant stakeholders.
Champion LHR Values: Lead by example and actively promote LHR principles throughout the organization.
Facilitate Open Communication: Maintain open communication channels with employees and address concerns promptly.
Support Employee Engagement: Encourage employee participation in LHR initiatives and committees.
Empower Managers: Equip managers with the knowledge and skills to handle LHR issues and foster a positive work environment.
Conflict Resolution: Assist employees and managers in resolving workplace conflicts effectively.
Employee Engagement: Organize events and initiatives to promote employee well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
Communication Support: Assist with communication efforts related to LHR policies and updates.
Ensure Compliance: Advise on legal requirements for LHR compliance and ensure all policies and practices are legally sound.
Review Contracts: Integrate LHR considerations into supplier and vendor contracts.
Manage Risk: Identify and mitigate potential LHR risks within the organization.
Uphold LHR Values: Report any suspected violations of LHR policies or observe a culture of fear or harassment.
Participate in Training: Attend LHR training programs and stay informed about policies and procedures.
Maintain Respectful Workplace: Treat colleagues with respect and dignity, fostering a positive work environment.

policy.monitoring:
Val Organics will publish a comprehensive social responsibility report annually.

The report will be available in a user-friendly format, both online and in print upon request.

The report will focus on specific KPIs established for each social responsibility area, such as:

Labor practices and employee well-being

Diversity and inclusion metrics

Community engagement initiatives

Ethical sourcing practices

Human rights considerations

The report will utilize data from various sources, including:

Internal monitoring and audits related to social responsibility performance.

Employee feedback surveys to gauge effectiveness and impact of social responsibility initiatives.

Records of communication with external stakeholders regarding social responsibility activities.

Legal and regulatory compliance documents ensuring adherence to relevant social responsibility standards.

Transparency: Regular reporting fosters transparency and accountability for Val Organics' social responsibility efforts.

Stakeholder Engagement: Open communication builds trust and collaboration with stakeholders regarding social responsibility commitments.

Continuous Improvement: Data-driven reporting allows for continuous improvement by identifying areas for progress in social responsibility practices.

Benchmarking: Reporting facilitates benchmarking against industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
policy.reviewMechanism:
To ensure the effectiveness and continuous improvement of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.'s Labor & Human Rights Policy, the following review mechanism shall be implemented:

The Human Resources Manager shall review the Labor & Human Rights least annually, or more frequently if significant changes occur in business operations, regulatory requirements, stakeholder expectations, or social responsibility practices.

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including employees, customers, suppliers, and community representatives, shall be considered during the review process.

The implementation of the Policy and progress toward achieving established social responsibility objectives and targets shall be evaluated to identify areas for improvement.

Social performance indicators, employee feedback, community engagement outcomes, and other relevant metrics shall be assessed against defined objectives and industry best practices.

Based on the review findings, necessary updates, corrective actions, and enhancements shall be recommended to strengthen the effectiveness of the Policy and align with evolving social responsibility standards.

Any revisions to the Policy shall be subject to approval by the CEO of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd., ensuring leadership commitment to social responsibility initiatives.

The outcomes of the review process and significant policy updates shall be communicated to relevant stakeholders, as appropriate.

This review mechanism will ensure that Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.'s Labor & Human Rights Policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with its commitment to employee well-being, ethical practices, and positive social impact.
